notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
[UPDATE #3]

[Fixed]
 Fixed  - Health bar does not work properly on client

 Fixed  - Sometimes Ratty can carry foods when died

 Fixed  - Some health bar bugs

 Fixed  - Some session joining bugs


[Added]

 Added  - Bot reload after 10 shot (5 seconds)

 Added  - New air elevator on Ratty nest. Ratty nest > Kids Room

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29890282/c7a7ff25d956c56965e96ddd68448589ea63052e.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29890282/0776bdb3f9463ad1415e74138a697c4ad976015b.jpg

 Added  - From now on, all Ratties have 3 respawn chance. (you will be able to enable / disable it in the lobby)

 Added  - Added x3 heart to health bar for representing your lives

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29890282/52746ac23cc686d87566cb49fcecbcd7c3cb98e3.png

 Added  - Ratty will not be able to take foods and revive his friend when he is in the spy mode in bucket/cardboard box anymore

notes.title: Major Update! New Map and New Features!
notes.notes:
[UPDATE #1]

[Fixed]
 Fixed - Camera clip through ceilings
 Fixed  - Now you can reset the car with "R" button if it gets stuck in tutorial
 Fixed  - There will be no dizzy symbol in your head after you die
 Fixed  - Lobby joining bugs
 Fixed  - Some session bugs
 Fixed  - The camera angle of Catty is enlarged

[Added]

 Added  - You can enable and disable minimap in the lobby

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29890282/64db76c1591e6277e5d9f511e31d0cec123e203f.png

 Added  - First Aid Station in Ratty's nest - You can refill your health with First Aid Station
